headline: Production at Dongfeng Honda Engine Impacted by Severe Ransomware Incident
body: A severe ransomware attack hit Dongfeng Honda Engine Co., Ltd., disrupting their plant operations. Key manufacturing systems, including execution and logistics software, have been encrypted, halting production at the site. While cybersecurity experts are working on recovery efforts, no clear timeline for resuming full operations has been issued. The company, a vital player in automotive engine supply, has engaged third-party specialists for system restoration.
